content.title: What time do 'Invincible' season 4 episodes air? See release schedule
content.text: The animated superhero TV series "Invincible" is back with a new season."Invincible" is about 17-year-old Mark Grayson, who inherits superpowers from his father and the world's most powerful hero, Omni-Man. He takes on the name "Invincible" after he develops super-strength, speed and flight. However, things are not as they seem when Mark discovers that his father is a scout for the Viltrumites, a bloodthirsty group of conquerors.In Season 4, the world is recovering from the Invincible War between all of Earth's superpowered individuals and military forces against evil variants of Invincible from across the multiverse. Mark is struggling with guilt as he fights to protect his home and the people he cares about. With a new threat, the fate of humanity could be altered forever.Here's when the new season of "Invincible" is coming out and where to watch "Invincible" Season 4.'Invincible' Season 4 release date"Invincible" Season 4 premiered on Wednesday, March 18.When is the new season of 'Invincible' coming out?Season 4, Episodes 1-3 of "Invincible" aired at 3 a.m. EST on Wednesday, March 18.What time does 'Invincible' come out?"Invincible" came out at 3 a.m. EST.'Invincible' Season 4 release scheduleHere is the release schedule for "Invincible" Season 4:Episodes 1-3: Wednesday, March 18.Episode 4: Wednesday, March 25.Episode 5: Wednesday, April 1.Episode 6: Wednesday, April 8.Episode 7: Wednesday, April 15.Episode 8: Wednesday, April 22.'Invincible' Season 4 trailerHere's the trailer for "Invincible" Season 4:How many episodes in 'Invincible' season 4?There are eight episodes in "Invincible" season four.How many season of 'Invincible' will there be?Amazon confirmed Season 5 was in progress. Though we're not sure how many seasons the show will have, the comic series it is based on has 144 issues, which could provide material for more seasons.Where to watch 'Invincible' Season 4?"Invincible" is an Amazon Prime Video original.Prime Video is available as part of the Amazon Prime membership, which costs $14.99 per month or $139 annually for an individual. You can also just get Prime access for $6.99. The young adult membership, for those ages 18 to 24, costs $7.49 per month or $69 per year.Do you have a tip or a question you need answered?
